item.title: Indiana Chamber CEO says child care will be major priority in 2026
item.description: The president and CEO of the Indiana Chamber of Commerce said Indiana's child care access is a major workforce retention issue.

item.title: Mozel Sanders Foundation feeds over 10,000 people on Thanksgiving Day
item.description: The Mozel Sanders Foundation continues its tradition of feeding hungry families on Thanksgiving, serving over 10,000 people in 2025 with the help of dedicated volunteers.

item.title: Colts' QB Daniel Jones says he's healthy, ready for Texans matchup
item.description: Colts quarterback Daniel Jones downplays lower leg injury, assures readiness for AFC South game against Houston. Indy aims to pad division lead.

item.title: 22-year-old arrested after 26-year-old was fatally shot in Washington County
item.description: A 26-year-old man was fatally shot in New Pekin, Indiana. A 22-year-old suspect was arrested and preliminarily charged with reckless homicide, state police say.

item.title: Winter storm to affect central Indiana Saturday and Sunday; cold air sticks around next week
item.description: Wintry weather is expected this weekend in Indiana, with a winter storm watch in effect. Prepare for colder temperatures and snowfall.

item.title: 2 dead after being found shot at east side house fire ruled arson
item.description: Two individuals were found shot at a house fire in Indianapolis, resulting in their deaths. Two children were rescued and are safe.

item.title: Indiana native Fuzzy Zoeller, known for 1979 Masters win and Tiger Woods joke, dies
item.description: Fuzzy Zoeller, a two-time major champion, dies at 74. His career was marked by a racially insensitive joke about Tiger Woods at the 1997 Masters.

item.title: 6-year-old boy in Indianapolis dies after self-inflicted gunshot wound
item.description: A 6-year-old boy dies from a self-inflicted gunshot wound in Indianapolis. IMPD warns against leaving guns unsecured. Family devastated during Thanksgiving holiday.

item.title: Winter storm watches call for heavy snowfall in much of Indiana
item.description: Winter storm watches issued for Indiana with heavy snow expected. Travel may be difficult.
